'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]]
****[[Ukraine]] declares a [[National day of mourning|day of mourning]] for the victims of the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] bombardment of [[Kyiv]] on July 2 as the death toll rises to 30. [https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-russia-strikes-kill-4-as-kyiv-holds-day-of-mourning/a-77813693 (DW)]
***[[Russia]]n [[missile]] and [[Aerial warfare in the Russo-Ukrainian war|drone strikes]] kill at least five people and injure ten others across Ukraine, including three people in [[Sumy]] when a drone struck their [[apartment]] building. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/3/four-killed-in-ukraine-a-day-after-deadliest-russian-attacks-this-year (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] strike nine [[substation]]s across [[Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine|Russian-occupied]] [[Crimea]] causing [[power outage]]s. [[Saky (air base)|Saky air base]] and [[Gvardeyskoye (air base)|Gvardeyskoye air base]] are also targeted with seven jets destroyed or damaged.  [https://english.nv.ua/nation/madyar-strikes-again-48-targets-hit-in-occupied-crimea-50621489.html (''The New Voice of Ukraine'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-two-dead-russian-border-regions-after-ukrainian-drone-attacks-2026-07-03/ (Reuters)]

***Russia reports that [[Russian Armed Forces|its forces]] have captured the [[Eastern Ukraine|eastern Ukrainian]] city of [[Kostyantynivka]], [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/russia-says-it-seized-eastern-ukrainian-stronghold-of-kostyantynivka-11724641 (AFP via NDTV)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]], [[Siege of El Obeid]]
***[[United Nations]] [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights|human rights chief]] [[Volker Türk]] issues a "red alert" warning in [[El-Obeid]], [[North Kordofan]], [[Sudan]], of a "[[Siege of El Obeid|catastrophe]]" and violence in the city. [https://abcnews.com/International/wireStory/human-rights-chief-sounds-red-alert-violence-sudans-134436763 (ABC News)] [https://www.modernghana.com/news/1507578/un-issues-red-alert-over-catastrophe-in-sudan.html (ModernGhana)]
**[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Sudan)|Sudanese foreign minister]] [[Mohi El-Din Salem]] says that the [[Government of Sudan|Sudanese government]] is ready to engage in "sincere initiatives" aimed at ending the [[civil war]] that started in April 2023. He also says that initiatives submitted by [[Transitional Sovereignty Council|Sovereign Council]] chairman and [[Sudanese Armed Forces|military]] head [[Abdel Fattah al-Burhan]] to the [[United Nations]] last year must be a part of this process. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/sudan-says-ready-to-engage-in-sincere-initiatives-to-end-war/3985491 (AA)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**The [[Israel]]i [[Israel Defense Forces|military]] and [[Shin Bet]] state that [[Hamas]] militant Muhammad Na'im Jandiya, who allegedly took part in [[Gaza war hostage crisis|taking]] [[List of Gaza war hostages|hostages]] during the [[Nahal Oz attack|attack]] on the [[Nahal Oz (kibbutz)|Nahal Oz]] [[kibbutz]] in the [[October 7 attacks]] on [[Israel]], has been killed in an [[airstrike]] in the northern [[Gaza Strip]], violating the ongoing ceasefire. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-901323 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/skqyajhmfg (Ynetnews)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Two [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police|policemen]], including an [[Station house officer|additional station house officer]], are killed, while a driver is injured, as gunmen [[Mass shooting|open fire]] on a mobile patrol vehicle in [[Mohmand District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/2012851/two-policemen-martyred-in-mohmand-attack (Dawn)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Impact of the 2026 Iran war on Iran]]
**[[State funeral of Ali Khamenei]]
***The [[state funeral]] of former [[Supreme Leader of Iran|Iranian supreme leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]], who was [[Assassination of Ali Khamenei|killed]] in an [[airstrike]] on [[Office of the Supreme Leader of Iran|his compound]] by Israel and the United States during the first day of the [[Iran]] war on February 28, begins as his body [[lies in state]] at [[Tehran]]'s [[Grand Mosalla of Tehran|Grand Mosalla]]. The funeral is expected to draw millions of attendees, including [[Foreign relations of Iran|foreign dignitaries]].
